services.desc: Art Gallery of St. Albert, Musée Héritage Museum and St. Albert’s Heritage Sites provide fun, educational non-profit programs. They are designed for families with children ages 5 to 13. History-based programs are offered at the museum and heritage sites, and art programs are instructed by professional art instructors right in the heart of downtown St. Albert. Programs are 1.5 hours in length and parents are always welcome but required to stay and assist any children under 7 years of age. blurb: Experience what it was like to go to school in a two-room schoolhouse, in the Little White School near downtown in Mission Park. Step back in time with one of our interpreters to 1948 when the school first opened. Book a personal tour (by appointment), visit the school as part of a community group gathering or rent the space for a private function.
